items.title: Leonard Miller is just straight up good. Super young (turns 23 in Nov.) and has plus physical tools for a forward at 6'10, 220 lbs, 7'2 wingspan. He's been one of the Bulls' best players in preseason, and they should be looking to extend him ASAP

items.title: The Ayo trade was really good for the Bulls, but people aren't ready to have that conversation yet. Leonard Miller is a baller, they lost enough games to move up for Caleb Wilson, and there would have been zero reason to give Ayo the 5/$112 he got from Minnesota. AK masterclass?
